messages:
sanjay: quick async: morning incident recap. same theme again 1 config drift + overly wide flag = error spike during rollout. need an operational checklist + ownership so this doesn't keep reappearing.
aya: painful. can we agree on a tiny set of automatic mitigations that run in under 2 minutes? soft degrade -> isolate -> rollback.
chris: propose this flow: 1) soft-shrink sampling 2) circuit-break on retry spikes 3) hard-kill flag if no recovery. also require telemetry so we can audit.
nina: suggested thresholds: 2m window, error_rate > 4% OR p95 latency > baseline + 150ms => trigger soft-shrink. if condition persists 3 mins => hard-kill. default canary caps: 2% global, 6% per region.
sanjay: assigning owners: - CHRIS: implement infra circuit-break + soft-shrink logic + smoke test (due Wed EOD) - NINA: default scope matrix + PR template checkbox for rollout scope (due Tue noon) - AYA: backfill "guardrail_in_place" column in postmortem tracker and run retro to tag last 15 incidents (due Thu) - OPS (ops-bot): create TICK-3999 and add observability sprint card for a canary heatmap and a 2-min alert (due Fri).
ops-bot: Created TICK-3999. Use `/claim` to assign.
chris: quick pseudocode I'll include in the spec:```
monitor(window=2m):
  if errors > 0.04 or p95_latency > baseline + 150ms:
    reduce_canary_sample(by=0.5)
    start_timer(3m)
    if not recovered by timer:
      if canary_scope > min_scope:
        trigger_flag_kill(flag_id)
      else:
        execute_rollback_flow(model_id)
    notify(#incidents, details)
```
aya: small addition: before hard-kill, post a one-line "soft-kill applied" with remediation owner and link to ticket so humans can act faster.
nina: also put a weekly flag-scope audit on the calendar and a simple alert if any flag > 10% without a recorded justification. helps catch accidental wide flags.
sanjay: decision list (to capture in tracker): soft-shrink -> hard-kill fallback, default scope caps (2%/6%), canary heatmap tile, 'guardrail_in_place' column, weekly audits, owners assigned.
chris: I'll draft an infra PR with tests that emulate soft-shrink and hard-kill. will include a small load test to validate latency on flag-kill path. ETA Wed.
ops-bot: TICK-3999 updated: assignees chris,nina,aya. due dates set.
sanjay: propose a 15m async follow-up next Monday to confirm blockers and review the spec PRs.
aya: works. I'll drop blockers in the ticket.
nina: ping me 15m before. I'll have the scope matrix ready. :thumbsup:
sanjay: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem board and send a short note to eng leadership summarizing the changes. if anyone wants to split items, mention here. :eyes:
